name: The Tome of Nobility
label: Quest
description: The Tome of Nobility: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I greet you once again, friend. I am more proud to call you friend than ever before--your dedication is a tribute to us all.

The time has come for me to bestow a great gift upon you. But know this, for now I give you this freely, but later, when time permits, this will be a much greater challenge to all paladins who choose to undertake my quest.
Speak to me again and I shall grant you a great boon.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Congratulations, and may the Light protect you.
